scenario.name: Vehicle ahead braking or stopping in congested traffic
scenario.description: The vehicle follows another in congestion or in free flow; the lead vehicle brakes hard, stops, or another vehicle cuts in

events.description: Does not brake when the vehicle ahead slows or stops

triggers.condition: Large vehicles alongside, blocking the LiDAR's view of the surroundings
Wet road reducing grip during braking or turning

goals.statement: Decelerate at least as much as needed to avoid a collision the planned trajectory avoids
Avoid unintended lateral motion out of the planned path
Do not enter an intersection, roundabout or crosswalk against right of way

scenario.meant: keeps a safe gap as it brakes
scenario.pass: No collision with the vehicle ahead; acceleration stays inside the envelope, the monitor restores the safe longitudinal distance, and a braking shortfall on a wet road switches to the secondary path

parameters.label: ODD-20 Ego speed: 19.9 km/h (range 0 to 48 km/h)
ODD-03 Posted speed limit: 30 mph (the stated bound)

parameters.parameter: Deceleration of the lead vehicle and cut-in gap
parameters.range: Bound stated by FSR-06.01, not yet fixed
parameters.label: Deceleration of the lead vehicle and cut-in gap: Bound stated by FSR-06.01, not yet fixed; the motion drawn is choreography

legend.plan: Autoware's planned path (EL-01 Autoware computer, rated QM)
legend.envelope: Safety monitor's envelope (EL-02, ASIL D); length not computed: the vehicle is not chosen yet (DQ-008)
legend.meant: Meant to do: keeps a safe gap as it brakes
legend.meant_mark: Dashed green: the path the pass criterion asks of the vehicle; green ring: where it is judged
legend.hazard: Where the hazard lies: HE-01.2 Accelerates into the vehicle ahead; HE-02.2 Does not brake when the vehicle ahead slows or stops
legend.key: Amber, ringed: the road user the scenario is about

ego.motion_label: Ego slows at 3 m/s², the firm level of FSR-03.02 (DQ-019, DQ-033); choreography, not Autoware's planned braking
